intro:
Solve each case with just one choice!
Train your observation and deduction skills
Quick mystery puzzles for sharp minds
description:
Read each case carefully and choose the option that leads closer to the truth.

The rules are simple: each question gives you two choices. Think like a detective, compare the details, and pick the answer that helps solve the case.

How to play:
・Read the case details
・Compare the two choices
・Use observation, logic, and intuition to find the right answer

Some cases may look easy at first, but assumptions can lead you in the wrong direction. Pay attention to small details and hidden clues.

Enjoy it at your own pace, one case at a time. It is great for quick breaks, solo play, or discussing the answer with family and friends.

Recommended for players who:
・Like mystery quizzes and detective stories
・Want a quick brain-training game
・Enjoy observation and deduction challenges
・Prefer simple controls and short puzzle sessions
・Want a casual game that can be enjoyed alone or with others

Make the right choice and uncover the truth behind each case!
